divergences.old: deps frisk --source sonatype scanning the git repository's manifests itself
divergences.toil: toil ossindex vulns checks an inventory: toil deps scan output from --from <file> or stdin (toil deps scan --include-transitive | toil ossindex vulns). The --ecosystem, --direct-only and --include-dev filters apply to that inventory
divergences.why: One command does one thing against one source; the scan is its own command and the sources compose with it (docs/integrations.md, dependency analysis).

divergences.old: deps frisk --source sonatype probing OSV.dev and Artifactory, as well as OSS Index, before every run
divergences.toil: toil ossindex vulns probes only OSS Index and never contacts OSV.dev or Artifactory. tier is "full" on every success once OSS Index answers, as the contract records
divergences.why: A command talks only to the public API it names in its own name.

divergences.old: deps frisk --source sonatype calling OSS Index anonymously, so a 401 reads as "ossindex.sonatype.org is not reachable", and the 429 advice names credentials no config key holds
divergences.toil: toil ossindex vulns needs a connection with a free account's username and token (TOIL_OSSINDEX_USERNAME, TOIL_OSSINDEX_TOKEN), sent as Basic auth only to the fixed host https://ossindex.sonatype.org. With none set up it fails with NOT_CONFIGURED before any request; a rejected credential is AUTH. Other probe failures keep the recorded "not reachable" error
divergences.why: Confirmed against the live OSS Index API on 2026-10-17 (PR #130's proof run: an anonymous component-report request got HTTP 401), so it is fixed as a declared change (#91 item 7; CLAUDE.md, The command contract).
